about: Labelled messages a shopper might get, for calibrating the Decisions thresholds (A5.2). Written and labelled by hand on 11 Nov 2026 by the person who built the check, so it tests what we thought of. Labels (1 yes, 0 no): d names a payment destination, p asks for payment, c new or changed payment details, o pay outside PayPal's checkout, i impersonation, u urgency or secrecy, g gift cards or crypto, f fee to release, l code or link, v overpay and refund, t too good to be true.
